scope.weekend_definition: Saturday and Sunday by UTC match date, grouped under the Saturday date

information_boundary.weekend_cutoff: Friday 00:00 UTC immediately before each grouped weekend
information_boundary.carryover: Previous-season matches inside the 180-day window may supplement current-season history.

environment.tier_A: Both teams have at least three current-season matches before the weekend cutoff.
environment.tier_B: Both teams have at least one current-season match before the weekend cutoff.
environment.tier_C: Informational only and cannot be selected.
environment.selection: Top five ranked Tier A/B environments among the four leagues active that weekend.

candidate_plan_B.possible_XI: Top 11 by starts, recency and average starting minutes over the team's last five pre-cutoff matches.

consistency_rule.procedure: Start with the highest remaining average-shots candidate and group all remaining candidates within 0.5 shots of that anchor.
within_similar_group_order: minimum shots across previous five starts descending
population standard deviation of shots across previous five starts ascending
average player share of team shots descending

board.replacement_policy: A provisional top-three player who fails confirmed-lineup checks is rejected; no lower-ranked replacement is promoted.

interpretation: This v2 rule was requested after the v1 retrospective results were inspected, so the comparison is exploratory rather than independent validation.
Candidates must represent the home team at possible-XI and confirmed-lineup stages.
Historical FotMob standard starting lineups stand in for the lineup-time confirmation step.
